verdict.rationale: Nitrokey 3 firmware is confirmed open source (Rust, dual Apache2.0/MIT licensed, tagged releases on GitHub) which lets engineers inspect what runs on the device, but the HSM applet is explicitly noted as not open source, and there is no evidence of an independent third-party security audit of the firmware. missing for 10: independent audit report, confirmation that all product lines (not just Nitrokey 3) are open source, no audit mention for the closed HSM applet.
